description: List this agent's past bookings at Aurinia XO (check-out before today), most recent first — cancelled ones included (see the status field). Paginated through limit (default 20, max 100) and offset.

limit.description: How many past stays to return, newest first. Default 20, at most 100.

offset.description: How many stays to skip before returning results — use it with limit to page back through older stays. Default 0.

name: list_past_bookings
